svg.title: What the number does not decide
svg.desc: Two stacked zones divided by a horizontal boundary. In the upper zone, the API's side, a question, a set of allowed answers and context feed a decision endpoint that returns a choice with a confidence. The boundary is labelled the estimate ends here. The lower zone, your side, shows labeled examples feeding your threshold, which splits into an automated route and a review queue. A footer reads: the API ships the top half of this picture; the threshold, the queue and the drift check are yours.

text.tspan: WHAT THE NUMBER DOES NOT DECIDE
A confidence value is an estimate. Turning it into a decision is a separate job.
THE API'S SIDE — what you buy
YOUR SIDE — what does not ship
The API ships the top half of this picture.
The threshold, the queue, and the drift check are yours.
